articles.summary: Ethernet is becoming the communications backbone of the software-defined vehicle. What began with high-bandwidth connections between central compute, domain controllers and advanced sensors is now extending much further toward the edge.
articles.title: Extending Ethernet Security to the Automotive Edge

articles.summary: 10BASE-T1S is a 10 Mb/s single-pair Ethernet technology that enables multiple devices, including sensors, actuators, and lighting controls, to communicate with a host MCU over a shared unshielded twisted-pair bus. The T1S physical wires are often located in remote locations, like peripheral zones, and are easily accessible for potential physical intervention, where the attacker may not only read the data, but also inject its own. Therefore, protecting T1S traffic is vitally important, and MACsec has been chosen as the industry-wide network security protocol.
articles.title: Protecting 10BASE-T1S Ethernet with MACsec

articles.summary: The MACsec-IP-360 is a purpose-built product, delivering the best area and latency for 10Mbit ports. It is a fully compliant MACsec solution and supports VLAN-in-clear case. It has all necessary functionality to autonomously protect a full port or multiple VLAN-based flows and count all required statistics. The IP comes in different variants that are tailored to customer requirements for the number of secure connections and other specific features. The feature set is compliant with the Open Alliance Automotive MACsec profile.
articles.title: MACsec-IP-360 Product Brief
